description: This file implements a batch span processor for OpenTelemetry tracing in Go, managing span batching, exporting, and queue handling with configurable options.

classes.name: batchSpanProcessor
classes.description: A span processor that batches spans asynchronously and exports them based on configurable parameters.

methods.name: NewBatchSpanProcessor
methods.description: Creates a new batch span processor with specified exporter and options.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: No-op method called when a span starts.

methods.name: OnEnd
methods.description: Enqueues a span for later processing when it ends.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Flushes remaining spans and shuts down the processor.

methods.name: ForceFlush
methods.description: Exports all spans that have not yet been exported.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a span, blocking or dropping based on configuration.

methods.name: enqueueBlockOnQueueFull
methods.description: Enqueues a span, blocking if the queue is full.

methods.name: enqueueDrop
methods.description: Enqueues a span, dropping if the queue is full.

methods.name: exportSpans
methods.description: Exports accumulated spans in the batch.

methods.name: processQueue
methods.description: Processes spans from the queue, batching and exporting them.

methods.name: nextProcessorID
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for each batch span processor instance.
